import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a countplot for the transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data, hue='is_fraud')
plt.title('Transaction Types by Fraudulent Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a barplot for the amount distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.distplot(data[data['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'], label='Legitimate')
sns.distplot(data[data['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'], label='Fraudulent')
plt.title('Amount Distribution by Fraudulent Status')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

# Create a barplot for the hour of day distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', data=data, hue='is_fraud')
plt.title('Hour of Day Distribution by Fraudulent Status')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

# Create a heatmap for the correlation matrix
corr_matrix = data[['amount', 'hour_of_day']].corr()
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation Matrix')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)

import pandas as pd

sns.distplot(data[data['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'], label='Legitimate')
sns.distplot(data[data['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'], label='Fraudulent')
plt.title('Amount Distribution by Fraudulent Status')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.legend(title='Fraudulent Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)
